paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 5.92, with a change of -0.84% from the prior close and -10.03% over the last 23 sessions. The price quote is as of August 21, 2026.

Recent news headlines include Fermi CEO Lee McIntire's statement that Texas Governor Abbott's pause on data center development does not negatively impact Project Matador, as well as the company's receipt of a US subpoena related to the project. Other news includes the appointment of Lee McIntire as interim CEO and construction underway at the Project Matador campus in Texas.

There have been 25 total filings, including 2 Form 4 filings, which report insider transactions. Recent filings include a Form 10-Q reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, as well as an 8-K filing announcing Lee McIntire's appointment as CEO with an annualized base salary of $750,000.
